title: Linearity of a monoidal comparison after iterated transport and scalar restriction
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category], and let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$, $H:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$ be lax monoidal functors (functors with natural tensor and unit maps satisfying the associativity and unit identities). Give $GF$ the composite lax monoidal structure, with tensor map $G(\mu^F_{U,V})\circ\mu^G_{FU,FV}$ and unit $G(\varepsilon^F)\circ\varepsilon^G$.
Let $e:GF\Rightarrow H$ be a monoidal natural transformation: for all $U,V$,
$$e_{U\otimes V}\circ G(\mu^F_{U,V})\circ\mu^G_{FU,FV}=\mu^H_{U,V}\circ(e_U\otimes e_V),\qquad e_{\mathbf1}\circ G(\varepsilon^F)\circ\varepsilon^G=\varepsilon^H.$$
Let $A,B,B'$ be monoid objects of $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$, respectively, and let $\psi:B\to FA$, $\psi':B'\to GB$, $\varphi:B'\to HA$ be morphisms of monoid objects [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], where the image monoids have the structures induced by the lax monoidal functors. Assume
$$\varphi=e_A\circ G(\psi)\circ\psi'.$$
For an $A$-module object $M$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], form the $B'$-modules
$$L(M)=\operatorname{Res}_{\psi'}\operatorname{mapMod}(G)\operatorname{Res}_{\psi}\operatorname{mapMod}(F)(M),\qquad R(M)=\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}\operatorname{mapMod}(H)(M),$$
using [def-sfb-modobj-transport] and [def-sfb-modobj-restriction]. Then $e_M:GFM\to HM$ is $B'$-linear from $L(M)$ to $R(M)$; explicitly, writing $a_M$ and $b_M$ for their actions,
$$e_M\circ a_M=b_M\circ(1_{B'}\otimes e_M).$$
